description: Na₂MgV₂(OF)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one O and five F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.46 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.51 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form distorted NaOF₅ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₄F trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-66°. The Na-O bond length is 2.29 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.57 Å. Mg is bonded to four O and one F atom to form distorted MgO₄F trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one VO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaOF₅ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₄F trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three VO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-71°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.42 Å. The Mg-F bond length is 2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted VO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaOF₅ octahedra, corners with two equivalent VO₄F₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄F trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent VO₄F₂ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄F trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-66°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-2.16 Å. There is one shorter (1.94 Å) and one longer (2.17 Å) V-F bond length. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form VO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaOF₅ octahedra, edges with two equivalent VO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₄F trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-59°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.95 Å. There is one shorter (1.95 Å) and one longer (2.01 Å) V-F bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Mg, and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to one Mg and three V atoms. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom.
